children.value: > Fact From Story a report conducted by a third party concluded that the company’s actions had an “adverse human rights impact” on Palestinian users’ right to freedom of expression and political participation.

> > Fact From Story The report noted that Meta’s moderation system may not be as precise for Arabic content as it was for Hebrew content, because the latter is a “more standardized language,” and suggested that reviewers may lack the linguistic and cultural competence to understand less common Arabic dialects like Palestinian Arabic.

> > > Fact From Story Advocacy groups have also raised concerns that Meta’s partnerships with government agencies, such as the Israeli Cyber Unit, politically influence the platform’s policy decisions.

> > > Fact From Story Meta struggles to navigate the cultural and linguistic nuances of Arabic, a language with over 25 dialects, and has been criticized for neglecting to adequately diversify its language resources.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge Government influence on social media platforms can lead to biased content moderation.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Lack of linguistic and cultural understanding can lead to misinterpretations and unfair moderation decisions.
> Commonsense Knowledge Freedom of expression and political participation are considered basic human rights.
